drafts.text:
You don't lose the account when the trade goes wrong.
You lose it earlier, the moment you decide the rule doesn't apply this time.
Once the rules are gone, the account is already gone.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply to @THouseTraders on the Sep 21 failure thread.
drafts.why: A real self-quote that's already a complete, citable aphorism as spoken, zero invention needed. Matches the account's strongest reach format, and the account has had no aphorism post since Sep 8.
drafts.why_es: Una autocita real que ya es un aforismo completo y citable tal como se dijo, cero invención necesaria. Coincide con el formato de mayor alcance de la cuenta, y no hay un post de aforismo desde el 8 sep.

drafts.text:
27 trades made me $1,105.
14 trades lost $3,148 and the account with it.
More trades isn't more edge. Most of the time it's just more chances to fight a trade that already told me I was wrong.
Overtrading is how one bad idea becomes a closed account.
drafts.source: @JasonKelleyUK's real observation ('27 trades vs 14 trades... half the number of trades to lose 3 times the wins says it all') plus Jesus's own real reply, Sep 21 thread. Numbers are Jesus's own, already public in the thread.
drafts.why: Real, already-public numbers doing the work instead of an abstraction. Direct continuation of the story the audience just read, while it's still fresh.
drafts.why_es: Números reales, ya públicos, haciendo el trabajo en vez de una abstracción. Continuación directa de la historia que la audiencia acaba de leer, mientras sigue fresca.

drafts.text:
Had strangers in my replies being kinder to me today than I've been to myself all week.
One said don't be so hard on yourself, it'll make coming back harder.
Maybe. Still sitting with a closed account and my own decision that put it there.
Anyone else better at forgiving other people's losses than your own?
drafts.source: @R3G5B7's real reply on the Sep 21 failure thread ('don't be so hard on yourself, it will make coming back harder') plus the general tone of the thread's replies.
drafts.why: The account's single strongest format for reach+replies combined, and it's honest about something real instead of manufacturing a generic question.
drafts.why_es: El formato individual más fuerte de la cuenta para alcance+respuestas combinados, y es honesto sobre algo real en vez de fabricar una pregunta genérica.

plan: The $6K Challenge failed Sunday night (14 trades, -$3,148, fighting an invalidated 30,000 level with almost no pause between entries).
